name: adapty-skills
description: Skills that hand your app's subscription surface to your agent: integrate the Adapty SDK on any mobile platform (iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, Unity, KMP, Capacitor), get the first sandbox purchase through, build and edit Flow Builder paywalls and onboardings, audit a flow before you publish, move paywall placements to flows, run Apple Search Ads, read which campaigns pay back in Adapty Attribution, turn a paywall or onboarding into ranked conversion tests, and answer a product, dashboard or API question straight from Adapty's docs.

interface.longDescription: Hand your mobile app's in-app purchase work to Codex. Integrate the Adapty SDK on iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, Unity, Kotlin Multiplatform or Capacitor and set up the dashboard through the Adapty CLI; diagnose a sandbox purchase that does not go through; build, translate and audit Flow Builder paywalls and onboardings; move paywall placements to flows; manage Apple Search Ads; read campaign payback in Adapty Attribution; and get ranked, testable conversion ideas for a paywall or onboarding. Needs an Adapty account for everything except the two teardown skills.
defaultPrompt: Integrate Adapty into this app with a paywall on the settings screen
My sandbox purchase isn't going through. Find out why
Is my onboarding flow ready to publish? Audit it
